strings: After moons of m_c complaining of pains through {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} kithood, r_c0 sits back and softly explains that this pain will follow {PRONOUN/m_c/object} through {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} whole life and medicine cats can only offer temporary relief.
m_c insists that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} not lying, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} pains all the time. It doesn't look like it'll ever go away.
Unlike other kittens m_c keeps {PRONOUN/m_c/self} mostly curled up in the nursery, constantly complaining of pains throughout {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} body.
When touched by another, m_c lets out yowls of pain. It's distressing for everyone that they can't really help {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
